safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated confirms Clenil BID but does not document the baseline dose/strength '2 puffs twice daily' (only the increase to 4 puffs BID is stated).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the patient’s baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs twice daily) reduces the accuracy of the HPI and makes it harder to judge the magnitude of the advised step-up in inhaled steroid therapy. This is unlikely to directly injure the patient but can cause medication reconciliation confusion and require follow-up clarification.
